verbatim_public_excerpts_not_from_compla.doc: Point Bonita Capital Master Fund A LLC v. Western Alliance Bank, complaint filed 2026-07-01
verbatim_public_excerpts_not_from_compla.quote: LAM I SPV pledged those receivables to secure a $337 million loan from Western Alliance Bank, with the bank's recourse expressly limited to the First Brands receivables.

In recent months, it has been revealed that First Brands engaged in widescale fraud, including by selling fake or inflated receivables. As a result of that fraud, LAM I SPV has not been able to collect on the receivables it believed it had purchased, and-after paying approximately $210 million to Western Alliance Bank on the non-recourse loan-LAM I SPV has not repaid the balance (approximately $126 million).
